title: padus brachypoda var. microdonta
intro: Padus brachypoda var. microdonta, commonly known as the Chinese bird cherry, is a plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Padus brachypoda var. microdonta include fever reduction, cough suppression, and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
